string.text: Dialog Greetings
Dialog Greetings
Dialog Greetings by Expand. Stalkers greet you when you start talking to them, not every time you walk past.
When a dialog opens
Greet when a dialog opens

The stalker says one of his greeting lines ("Hello", "Hi there"...) when you open a dialog with him. Hostile and wounded stalkers stay silent, and so do traders and others without greeting voice lines.
Greeting chance (%)
Chance that the stalker greets you when the dialog opens. 100 = always, lower = he sometimes just starts talking.
Greet the same stalker again after (seconds)
How long the same stalker stays silent after greeting you, so reopening a dialog (for example after trading) doesn't repeat the greeting. 0 = greets every time a dialog opens.
Companions greet too
Your companions also greet you when you open a dialog with them. Off by default, because you talk to companions often to give orders.
When you walk past
No greeting when walking past
Stalkers no longer say hello every time you come within 3 m of them. Turn off to hear the vanilla greetings again (then a stalker may greet you twice: when you walk up and when the dialog opens).
No weapon warnings when walking past
Stalkers also stop telling you to put your weapon away or to stop when you walk up to them with a weapon in your hands. They still react to you as usual; only the voice line is skipped.
No reaction to a raised weapon

Stalkers no longer aim at you, stop you or block the talk animation when you walk up to them with a weapon in your hands; they react as if your weapon were lowered. Story characters with their own rules (base checkpoints, guards) still react. Applies at once to stalkers nearby.
Other
Debug log

Writes [DialogGreetings] lines to the game log (xray_*.log): every greeting, every muted line, why a stalker stayed silent, and the sound name of every voice line a stalker within 20 m starts. Only for bug reports.
